I’m very happy to share that my book Electronic Lyre (EU Press SPb) is on the 2026 Andrei Bely Prize shortlist in “Humanities Research.” 🧵

The Andrei Bely Prize is Russia’s first non-state literary award, founded in 1978. It’s known for its symbolic 1-ruble prize and its commitment to aesthetic experimentation. Being listed alongside scholars like Pavel Uspensky is a genuine honor.
